+    choices = []

+                break
+            if name in pins and version != pins[name]:

+                break
+        if invalid:

+        constraints = {name: [] for name in selected}
+        for name, bounds in data.get("roots", {}).items():

+        graph = {name: [] for name in selected}
+        closure = set(data.get("roots", {}))
